dedupe_keys.name: modeled electricity demand profiles for electric transit bus depots in the united states nrel

description: This dataset gives modelled hourly electricity demand profiles over one week for electric transit bus depots in the United States, as described in the NREL technical report 'Hourly Load Profile Dataset for Electric Transit Bus Depots in the United States' (NREL/TP-5400-92140, 2025) by Bo Liu, Tim Jonas, Kara Podkaminer and Brennan Borlaug. It was produced by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory with funding from the US Department of Energy Vehicle Technologies Office to show how fleet electrification changes depot power demand. Coverage: transit bus depots across the United States, hourly resolution, representative one-week profiles; the record was published on 30 December 2024 with DOI 10.7799/2565433. Access: DOE Data Explorer record and DOI landing page, with the method in the linked report. Licence and cost: free to access; no licence is stated on the record, so terms should be checked in the NREL data repository. Caveats: profiles are modelled, not metered, and depot-level assumptions on fleet size, schedules and charger power shape the results. It supports distribution grid capacity planning for bus electrification, studies of transit resilience to power outages and interdependency analysis, and complements the NREL heavy-duty depot charging load profiles and the FlexDepot model catalogued here.
